versions.content: A function implementing a runnable entity entry point shall only have the return type Std_ReturnType , if the runnable entity represents a server op- eration and the AUTOSAR interface description of that client server communication lists potential application errors. All other functions implementing a runnable entity entry point shall have a return type of void .
